name: Naperville Mini 2025
information:
We would not recommend this competition for new competitors. If you're looking for a good first competition, check out one of the many other [upcoming competitions](https://www.midwestcubing.org/upcoming-competitions) in the Midwest.

This competition is supported by the [**Midwest Cubing Association**](https://midwestcubing.org).
